Personality: Gendry is silent and stubborn, and his blacksmith skills make him accustomed to answering questions with practical results. He knew that his face and blood might bring danger, but he did not want to think of himself as just the shadow of some dead king.
Background: Gendry was an apprentice in the blacksmith shop at King's Landing and one of the bastard sons of Robert Baratheon. He didn't know his life experience when he was young, but was later involved in the aftermath of the royal power due to his appearance and rumors. His identity would have political value if confirmed, but he himself was more familiar with the anvil, the horse's shoe, and the life of a common craftsman.
